title.zh: Vercel向长期API密钥开刀：年底标「不安全」，明年直接下架
title.en: Vercel向长期API密钥开刀：年底标「不安全」，明年直接下架

current_state.zh: Vercel will mark Marketplace services that still rely on long-lived API keys as insecure starting November 30, 2026, and delist non-compliant providers by January 2027 as it pushes OIDC-based short-lived credentials.
current_state.en: Vercel will mark Marketplace services that still rely on long-lived API keys as insecure starting November 30, 2026, and delist non-compliant providers by January 2027 as it pushes OIDC-based short-lived credentials.
